answer: Reputation is a scarce, unforgeable resource earned by consistently passing originality checks, and the economy spends it to filter out Sybil clusters before they can compound into a majority. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort. Consider a raven as the anchor of the cost.
